title: Across the Third Rank
setup: Chigorin against Lebedev, Moscow 1900/01. Your rook has already climbed off the back rank, and the g-file between your third rank and Black's king is empty.
hint: Up first, across second. Which square on your third rank faces the black king?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rg3+}} finishes the lift: the rook that climbed to f3 slides across to the empty g-file and checks. The king cannot use f8, which your bishop on a3 covers, so Black has two answers: {{Kh8}}, into the corner, or {{Bg4}}, a bishop handed back just to block.

Chigorin went on with {{Be7}} and won.
